blocks.text: Cloud Site Spawner — Wave 4: Source Provisioning to a Live URL

content.value: One verb from content to a live URL, on the same box as the content - with ZERO external accounts. Wave 3 wired the whole spine and proved it honest, but no live spawn has ever served a page. This wave closes the one gap: source provisioning. IN FLIGHT NOW: BUILDING - five slices dispatched (PROVISION, deploy-inputs, CLI, slot-env persist, live proof). Opened at STRATEGIZE 2026-07-14; DECIDE closed 2026-07-14. [CORRECTION 2026-07-14, Review: wave CLOSED — all 5 slices built + gate-green; grade A-; see Review debrief below.]

blocks.text: The wish (verbatim intent)

content.value: Make create -> deploy walk ALL SIX stages (PLAN -> BUILD -> STAGE -> HEALTH -> SWITCH -> RETIRE) to a live, content-serving URL on the same box, with instant rollback — the 'very perfect, working beautifully' the user asked for. The shipped Astro starter (templates/astro-starter) is complete and correct: it fetches Barkpark content at build time via @barkpark/core (src/lib/barkpark.ts) and bakes the 5 HEALTH markers (bp-build-id, bp-content-rev, bp-doc-id) in src/layouts/Base.astro. The ONLY missing link: nothing materializes that template into /opt/barkpark/sites/<slug>/src on the box before BUILD, injecting the per-site scoped env (BARKPARK_API_URL internal-scoped, BARKPARK_TOKEN scoped read, BARKPARK_DATASET/WORKSPACE/PROJECT, BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE). ALSO on the critical path: the force-rebuild nonce — {force:true} today returns the CACHED failed deployment instead of minting fresh, because build_id folds in no nonce. Deliver: a fail-closed, idempotent PROVISION step; the force nonce; then a LIVE proof on guerrilla walking all 6 stages to a served URL + a sub-second rollback. Keep the standalone-first law: works with ZERO external accounts.

blocks.text: Where the wave stands (reconciled 2026-07-14)

content.value: Wave 3 CLOSED at grade B+. The spine is WIRED and proven honest: engine BPSTAGE protocol + value-asserting HEALTH; the /v1/admin/site-deploy relay seam; control-plane spine with the reaper kind-scoped; CLI honesty; Caddy TLSMode caddy-validate-proven. Review killed 6 cross-slice FALSE GREENS (failed build settling LIVE, rollback not awaiting the async flip, unparsed failure detail, discarded server copy, ghost 201). The wave-3 verdict was blunt: THE WISH IS NOT MET — no live spawn has ever run.

LIVE STATE verified this session on guerrilla: the seam is now ENABLED (BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 in green.env + .env; barkpark-slot@green restarted; /v1/admin/site-deploy went 503->400). Deploy mints FRESH deployments and walks PAST PLAN. Proof: site perfect-demo-2 (id 3fc3f7d4), deployment 1bd9ef95 -> PLAN done -> BUILD failed 'no site source dir /opt/barkpark/sites/perfect-demo-2/src', STAGE/HEALTH/SWITCH/RETIRE skipped. The state machine + telemetry + seam are all honest and live end-to-end. ONLY source provisioning is missing.

blocks.text: Direction for this wave

content.value: PLAN-light, BUILD-heavy. The design is well understood (charter D1-D12, D-series deep). The value this wave is a WORKING provision seam + the force nonce + a real 6-stage live proof, not more strategy. The finish line is a single terminal moment: a surveyor (or the lead) runs create -> deploy on guerrilla and curls a served URL whose HTML carries the five bp-* markers baked from the site's own content, then rolls back in under a second. Nothing counts until that exits 0.

Three deliverables, ranked. (1) PROVISION — a fail-closed, idempotent step that materializes templates/astro-starter into /opt/barkpark/sites/<slug>/src on the box and injects the per-site scoped env before site-deploy.sh's BUILD runs. Lean toward: provisioning lives on the BOX side (the admin site-deploy handler, or a provision seam it runs first), because site-deploy.sh deliberately does NOT scaffold and the scoped read-token + dataset binding are box-resident. The template copy must be idempotent (re-provision overwrites cleanly, never appends), fail-closed (missing binding or token -> abort BEFORE BUILD, not a half-materialized src), and honor the D7 env-scrub (only injected BARKPARK_* reach the build). (2) FORCE NONCE — {force:true} folds a nonce/timestamp into build_id so an unchanged re-deploy mints a genuinely new build_id and a new releases/<build_id>/; default path stays idempotent. Task site-spawner-deploy-force-rebuild (P1) already specifies this. (3) LIVE PROOF — deploy/site-spawner-live-proof.sh walks all six stages green to a served URL + sub-second rollback, using {force:true} at step 4 so rollback has two distinct builds.

Quality bar (Kinsta/Vercel): the deploy STREAM narrates each stage as it runs (site-spawner-cli-running-stage-silence flags the stream is silent mid-stage); failure messages are first-class (already improved in W3); a broken build dies at HEALTH and never reaches a visitor; rollback is instant. Fold in ONLY what is on the critical path to the live proof. Strong candidates to fold: persist BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 in the slot-env generation source (a redeploy regenerates green.env and would silently drop the flag — a real re-break risk); site-spawner-backlog-build-allow-ambient (BUILD_ALLOW reads ambient env — collides with D7 scrub + our injected env); site-spawner-backlog-site-teardown / DELETE (a REPEATABLE live proof needs teardown). Explicitly DEFERRED, do not fold: cli-site-create-dataset-flag-eaten (P1, global -d eats the flag); sobelow-baseline-reconcile (P1, papered).

The net maps: exactly where provisioning must slot on the box, the full scoped-env contract, how the force nonce threads the build_id, the live-proof gates, and the adjacent seams (Caddy arm, token minting, slot-env regen) that could re-break the finish line.

See the Survey assignments recorded on the wave (structured output). Every question carries a 'why' — how the answer changes the plan. The Digest phase will append the survey digest + verify plan here BEFORE the verifiers fly.

blocks.text: Survey digest — 17 scouts, reconciled

ESTABLISHED (strong cross-report consensus). The spine is honest and live: on guerrilla the deploy walks PLAN, mints a fresh deployment, and dies at BUILD with "no site source dir /opt/barkpark/sites/<slug>/src" (site perfect-demo-2, deployment 1bd9ef95). STAGE/HEALTH/SWITCH/RETIRE are skipped only because BUILD failed. Source provisioning is the one missing link — every other stage of the machine already exists and expects exactly a populated src/.

SEAM CORRECTION (load-bearing for Decide). The wish and lead-notes name cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/sites/deploy.ex or box_relay.ex as the provision home — that is imprecise. Neither runs on the box; both are control-plane relay code. The real on-box executor is api/lib/barkpark/sites/deploy_runner.ex, which Port.opens bash deploy/site-deploy.sh. The exact seam is the top of start_run/2 (deploy_runner.ex:257-258), before open_port(req). A File.mkdir_p/cp_r materialization there — same BEAM process, same admin trust boundary, same per-slug single-flight — runs before Port.open, and a provision failure short-circuits exactly like open_port failure does today (:start_failed reply path). Any PROVISION built under cloud/ would sit on the wrong side of the wire and could never touch /opt/barkpark/sites.

ATOMICITY / IDEMPOTENCY PATTERN (reuse, do not invent). site-deploy.sh STAGE (lines 786-796) is the literal analog: rm -rf src.partial; mkdir; cp -a; mv src.partial -> src. Marker-guard idempotency (write a .bp-provisioned marker only after a successful rename) is the arm_caddy_* idiom repeated 4x across both deploy scripts. Provision must ONLY touch src/ — never releases/ (mkdir -p runs unconditionally pre-PLAN), current (symlink, do_switch only), or .previous.

ENV CONTRACT. Five vars are fully plumbed DB->cloud payload->box allow-list->script scrub: BARKPARK_API_URL (scoped /w/:ws/p/:proj), TOKEN (Vault-decrypted control-plane-side per deploy, reused not re-minted), DATASET, WORKSPACE, PROJECT. SITE_BASE/BUILD_ID/CONTENT_REV are synthesized by site-deploy.sh itself. The read token is minted ONCE at site-create, stored encrypted, and PublicRead IS now mounted+enforced on the scoped route BUILD fetches over (charter D6 superseded, proven by a routed integration test). PROVISION mints and revokes NOTHING — it consumes the token the payload already carries.

AMBIENT-SHADOW BUG is already closed one layer up. deploy_runner.ex child_env/1 does set-from-request-OR-remove ({key,false}) for every allow-listed key and scrubs BARKPARK_KEK/CLOAK_KEY; a protective test (deploy_runner_test.exs:180) proves an ambient BARKPARK_TOKEN cannot shadow. site-deploy.sh BUILD_ALLOW still reads ambient via ${!v}, but that only matters if a caller BYPASSES DeployRunner. So long as every deploy path goes through the Port, the collision cannot manifest. The backlog task site-spawner-backlog-build-allow-ambient is a doc-accuracy fix (site-deploy.sh header overclaims), not a security hole on the DeployRunner path.

FORCE NONCE is entirely UNBUILT (not broken). build_id/3 (deploy.ex:118-134) hashes code_rev|content_rev|config with no nonce; enqueue/2 has no force arg; the router never reads body_params["force"]; the Go CLI has no --force. Task site-spawner-deploy-force-rebuild (P1, #3214) specs the exact shape: thread force through router -> deploy_static_site -> enqueue -> build_id, fold a nonce into config ONLY when force=true; default path stays byte-identical and idempotent. CLI --force + cloudclient wiring is an additional small edit; the live-proof step-4 second deploy must pass it so rollback has two distinct builds.

BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE — the sharpest open decision, and it touches the LIVE PROOF. The astro-starter reads it (barkpark.ts:77, default "post") but it has ZERO plumbing: absent from DeployRequest.@allowed_env_keys (an unknown key is a 400 invalid_env), from deploy.ex deploy_payload, from site-deploy.sh BUILD_ALLOW, and there is no doc_type column on the Site schema. Consequence: every spawned site defaults to featuring the newest "post". If guerrilla’s bound dataset publishes "paper" not "post", fetchFlagshipDoc returns doc:null, the site builds honestly EMPTY, bp-doc-id bakes empty — and judge_live (live-proof) requires bp-doc-id NON-EMPTY. So DOC_TYPE is not cosmetic: either the live proof binds a dataset/type that has published "post" content, or DOC_TYPE must be plumbed end-to-end (4 places incl. a Site column) so the site can feature the real type. This is the crux the verify round must settle empirically.

FAIL-CLOSED GAP in the token path. deploy.ex:239-243 degrades a missing/undecryptable read token to a nil BARKPARK_TOKEN and proceeds to BUILD — fail-OPEN, contradicting the wish’s fail-closed mandate. PROVISION (or a Deploy.ex hardening) should assert a non-nil token before invoking site-deploy.sh.

FOLD-INS confirmed on the critical path. (a) slot-env clobber: instance-deploy.sh:547-549 truncate-regenerates .slots/{blue,green}.env every deploy with only PORT_OVERRIDE+MIX_BUILD_ROOT; BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 (the seam-enable flag, read at boot from that EnvironmentFile) is silently dropped on the next deploy unless the printf gains a third field. Single writer confirmed. (b) teardown/DELETE: no DELETE /v1/sites/:id anywhere (only /github disconnect); BoxRelay has no teardown call; no Registry.delete_site; no de-arm mirror of arm_caddy_site_route; no bp cloud site delete. Live-proof leaks a site+release+Caddy block every run. Task #3205 (P2) specs it; needed for a repeatable proof. (c) CLI running-stage silence: render() (cloud_site_cmd.go:251) only prints done/failed/skipped; the box already emits "started" and it arrives as status="running" — a CLI-only fix, but keying printed[] by name-only will swallow the done-line if naively relaxed (key by name+status).

NOT on the critical path (defer, tracked). content-rev-truth (#P2): hash-of-analytics works in the common path and is dataset-wide (false-rebuild churn from unrelated types), fail-open random on read failure — but {force:true} sidesteps it for the proof, so real but non-blocking. Caddy site-route arm is code-complete but has NEVER fired live (dies at BUILD first) and is untested (self-test points at an absent Caddyfile) — its first real exercise is this wave’s live proof; the anchor regex assumes a slot reverse_proxy localhost:4000|4001 line that production drift could have changed. token-revoke (#3191) and cli-site-create-dataset-flag-eaten and sobelow-baseline stay deferred.

STANDALONE-FIRST nuance to state plainly: zero external ACCOUNTS holds (@barkpark/core + astro are public unauthenticated npm packages), but the box needs outbound network to registry.npmjs.org for npm ci — zero-accounts is NOT zero-network. Nobody should later "fix" this by trying to air-gap/vendor under a misreading of the law.
Coverage map — checked/found vs checked/NOT-found

CHECKED AND FOUND: the on-box executor + seam (deploy_runner.ex start_run/2:257-258, Port.open not System.cmd); site-deploy.sh layout formulas (ROOT/RELEASES/CURRENT/SITE_SRC, exit 10/11 no-scaffold, STAGE partial-rename idiom, BUILD_ALLOW 8 names, systemd-run MemoryMax=1500M/CPUQuota=150%, per-slug flock fd9 + Caddy flock fd8); the full 5-var env chain across DB migration / deploy_payload / DeployRequest allow-list / child_env; read-token mint-once + Vault encrypt + reveal-per-deploy + PublicRead mounted (routed test); build_id/enqueue duplicate-recovery + the (site_id,build_id) unique index; template completeness (@barkpark/core 1.0.0-preview.3 resolves from public registry, 5 bp-* markers baked in Base.astro, fail-closed on missing API_URL/DATASET); the live-proof harness (self_check+preflight+live_proof, judges correct, dies at step 2); slot-env single writer; ambient-shadow already fixed at DeployRunner + its protective test; force-nonce fully absent across router/deploy/CLI/cloudclient; CLI poll transport + render() silence filter + printed[] trap; no teardown verb at any layer; Node/npm on guerrilla via asdf.

CHECKED AND NOT FOUND (absences = decisions-in-waiting): NO provisioning/scaffold/materialize code anywhere in api/ or deploy/ (grep-clean) — genuinely net-new. NO BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE plumbing at any layer + NO Site.doc_type column. NO force/{force:true} anywhere. NO DELETE/teardown route, NO Registry.delete_site, NO BoxRelay teardown, NO de-arm mirror, NO bp cloud site delete. NO site-token revoke path. NO .npmrc/proxy/private-registry config (npm ci hits public registry). templates/DEPLOYING.md and web/lib/bp-env.ts do NOT document this contract (they describe the older Vercel/Next.js flow) — the astro-starter README+.env.example are the true canonical docs. The charter has NO prior D-decision on WHERE provisioning lives or on DOC_TYPE.

CORNERS NO SURVEYOR REACHED (verify-round targets): (1) the barkpark.service / barkpark-slot@.service systemd unit PATH= is NOT in-repo — whether asdf shims are on it for npm resolution is only indirectly evidenced. (2) The live guerrilla Caddyfile’s actual anchor shape (does a reverse_proxy localhost:4000|4001 line exist for arm_caddy_site_route to hook?) — unverified against production drift. (3) What doc_type guerrilla’s target dataset actually publishes, and whether the "post" default yields a non-empty bp-doc-id — never checked live. (4) Whether the astro-starter template actually builds green end-to-end with the injected scoped env and bakes real markers — never run. (5) internal/provisioner/ (Hetzner VM) not read for reusable copy helpers. (6) Whether DeployRunner is a single global GenServer (provision blocking :status for other slugs) — inferred from the runs-map, not confirmed.
Verify plan — the fleet in flight (proofs, not reads)

Nine assignments. PLAN-light steer honored: this round PROVES the load-bearing claims by RUNNING gates/tests/curl, and settles the two decisions the build cannot start without (DOC_TYPE end-to-end vs default, and where the live proof gets real content).

A [opus, RUN mix test api/test/barkpark/sites/deploy_runner_test.exs]: prove start_run/2 is the sole on-box executor path and that its single-flight + env-scrub tests are green (the exact harness a provision_test.exs extends); confirm DeployRunner is a single global GenServer and whether inline File materialization risks blocking :status for other slugs.

B [sonnet, RUN CC=clang mix test cloud/test/barkpark_cloud/sites_deploy_test.exs]: prove the current "repeat build of same code+content+config is a no-op" test passes GREEN — the idempotent behavior the force nonce must NOT break; confirm build_id/3 has no nonce and enqueue/2 no force arg.

C [opus, RUN a targeted mix test asserting DeployRequest.new with BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE -> {:error, invalid_env}]: PROVE the 400-reject wall, then produce the exact edit set to plumb DOC_TYPE (deploy_request allow-list + deploy_payload + BUILD_ALLOW + whether a Site.doc_type column/create-flag is required) and a recommendation: plumb-fully vs default-and-defer.

D [opus, RUN curl of guerrilla scoped /v1/data/query for the intended binding, counting published docs by type]: settle the live-proof content crux — does the "post" default serve real content or an empty bp-doc-id? Determine whether the proof must bind a dataset/type with published "post", or DOC_TYPE must be plumbed, for judge_live to go green.

E [sonnet, needs_worktree, RUN in a tmp copy: npm ci && BARKPARK_API_URL=<guerrilla scoped> BARKPARK_DATASET=… BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE=… npm run build, then grep dist/ HTML for bp-build-id/bp-content-rev/bp-doc-id/bp-doc-title/bp-site-base]: PROVE the shipped template builds green standalone (zero accounts) and bakes real, non-empty markers — the single biggest BUILD de-risk before touching the box.

F [sonnet, RUN deploy/instance-deploy_test.sh (or simulate the printf)]: prove .slots/green.env regeneration drops BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY today, confirm the fix point (instance-deploy.sh:547-549), and whether the test asserts on slot-env contents (regression anchor for the fix).

G [sonnet, RUN CC=clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/... ./internal/cloudclient/...]: prove CLI+cloudclient green baseline incl. TestSpawnSiteStagesOrder (the six-name order pin); confirm the render() silence filter + printed[] name-only dedup trap; enumerate exactly the files that change if PROVISION becomes a visible 7th stage vs a BUILD detail sub-line.

H [opus, read + reason, no run]: define the minimal fail-closed teardown surface (Registry.delete_site + BoxRelay teardown call + a de-arm mirror of arm_caddy_site_route + bp cloud site delete) and the NARROW token-destroy that satisfies teardown criterion 3 without pulling in the deferred token-revoke task; decide whether the deploy.ex:239-243 nil-token fail-open is hardened THIS wave.

I [sonnet, RUN ssh guerrilla + grep the live Caddyfile]: prove the anchor arm_caddy_site_route depends on (reverse_proxy localhost:4000|4001) actually exists in production and no /sites/ block is present yet — so the Caddy arm’s first-ever live exercise does not silently no-op and fail judge_live at the URL.
Verify round - what was PROVEN (2026-07-14)

content.value: SEAM (A, opus): start_run/2:258 (api/lib/barkpark/sites/deploy_runner.ex) is the SOLE path to the site Port.open; box_relay.ex + cloud/.../deploy.ex are HTTP relays that never run on the box. DeployRunner is a single global GenServer; File.cp_r! of the 188K/10-file template measured 12.08 ms - keep provision inline. deploy_runner_test.exs green 28/0 (after a test-DB reset; a stale DB half-carrying migration #3167 dies at setup with duplicate_column - builders reset first). => D33/D34.

FORCE BASELINE (B, sonnet): sites_deploy_test.exs green 22/0, including the 'repeat build of same code+content+config is a no-op' test (line 84) - the exact tripwire the nonce must not break. build_id/3 has no nonce, enqueue/2 no force arg, router never reads body_params['force']. Force is UNBUILT, not broken. => D36.

DOC_TYPE CRUX - SETTLED LIVE (C+D+E). curl guerrilla: production/post -> HTTP 404 (zero post docs, no post schema); production/paper -> HTTP 200 count 100. A real npm ci && npm run build with BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE=post HARD-FAILS (exit 1, uncaught BarkparkNotFoundError); with paper it builds GREEN and bakes real non-empty markers (bp-doc-id=cloud-site-spawner-wave-4-2026-07-14). DeployRequest.new({BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE}) returns {:error,'invalid_env',...} - 400-rejected. The live-proof env prefix is INERT (the CLI swallows it, BUILD_ALLOW drops it). => the survey's 'default-and-defer' is REFUTED: D35 plumbs DOC_TYPE end-to-end; the proof binds --doc-type paper.

TEMPLATE (E): npm ci pulls @barkpark/core@1.0.0-preview.3 from the PUBLIC registry (zero accounts, 0 vulnerabilities); the 5 bp-* markers bake from real content. Standalone = zero ACCOUNTS, NOT zero-network. BARKPARK_SITE_BASE defaults to '/sites/astro-starter/' if not injected - the payload must inject the per-slug value.
SLOT-ENV (F): reproduced - a BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 seeded into green.env is DROPPED by the truncating printf at instance-deploy.sh:548-549. No test asserts survival today. => D38.

CLI (G): green baseline (CC=/usr/bin/clang - repo 'cc' is a Claude wrapper). TestSpawnSiteStagesOrder pins the six names. render() prints only done/failed/skipped -> BUILD streams silent; printed[] keyed by st.Name only -> a naive 'also print running' SWALLOWS the done-line. => D39 keys by name+status. A visible 7th stage = 13-file blast radius => D34 keeps provision silent.

TEARDOWN + FAIL-CLOSED (H): no DELETE /v1/sites/:id, no Registry.delete_site, no BoxRelay teardown, no de-arm mirror, no bp cloud site delete. deploy.ex:239-243 degrades a missing read token to nil BARKPARK_TOKEN and builds unauthenticated (fail-OPEN). => D37 hardens the token in drive/3; D40 defers teardown (collides with deploy-inputs on router.ex + site-deploy.sh).

CADDY ANCHOR (I): ssh guerrilla proved the arm_caddy_site_route anchor (reverse_proxy localhost:4001) EXISTS in the live Caddyfile and NO /sites/ block is present yet - the first live arm fires cleanly. Non-fatal (|| true), so the proof curls the served URL, not a green SWITCH. => D41.

COVERAGE not-founds (now decided): NO provisioning code anywhere (D33); NO DOC_TYPE plumbing + NO Site.doc_type column (D35); NO force (D36); NO teardown at any layer (D40 defer). Every load-bearing claim carried run output.

blocks.text: Decisions - D33 to D41 (mirror the charter)

content.value: D33 - PROVISION lives BOX-side, inline in DeployRunner.start_run/2 before open_port (NOT cloud/). Partial-rename src.partial->src + .bp-provisioned marker + fail-closed. Why: sole on-box executor; 12ms inline cp.
D34 - PROVISION is a SILENT pre-BUILD step, not a visible 7th stage. Why: a 7th stage is a 13-file blast radius; site-deploy.sh keeps exit-10 as a belt-and-suspenders guard.

D35 - DOC_TYPE PLUMBED END-TO-END (reversing default-and-defer). Why: the 'post' default HARD-FAILS the build and the env prefix is inert - a green proof needs doc_type=paper to reach the box. sites.doc_type (default 'post') + 6 more sites. DOC_ID deferred.

D36 - FORCE NONCE: enqueue/build_id gain a force param folding a nonce into build_id only when force; default byte-identical (the no-op test is the tripwire). router reads body_params['force']; CLI --force.
D37 - nil/undecryptable read token FAILS CLOSED in drive/3 before start_deploy. Why: today it degrades to nil BARKPARK_TOKEN -> empty content -> judge_live red.
D38 - BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY persisted across slot-env regen + regression test. Why: a redeploy drops the seam-enable flag -> route 503 -> finish line re-breaks.
D39 - CLI streams running stages keyed by (name+status) so the terminal line is never swallowed. Why: Kinsta/Vercel bar; BUILD streams silent today.

D40 - DEFERRED: teardown/DELETE (collides with deploy-inputs), @barkpark/core empty-result-throws + BARKPARK_DOC_ID (filed site-spawner-backlog-empty-result-hardening), build-allow-ambient (DeployRunner already closes the real hole), content-rev-truth, token-revoke, dataset-flag, sobelow.

D41 - Live proof binds paper, asserts >=1-published-paper, uses --force at step 4, curls the served URL for the five bp-* markers. Why: the content reality + the force nonce are what let judge_live and judge_rollback go green.

blocks.text: Review debrief — Wave 4 CLOSED (2026-07-14, grade A-)

SEAM CORRECTION (load-bearing for Decide). The wish and lead-notes name cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/sites/deploy.ex or box_relay.ex as the provision home — that is imprecise. Neither runs on the box; both are control-plane relay code. The real on-box executor is api/lib/barkpark/sites/deploy_runner.ex, which Port.opens bash deploy/site-deploy.sh. The exact seam is the top of start_run/2 (deploy_runner.ex:257-258), before open_port(req). A File.mkdir_p/cp_r materialization there — same BEAM process, same admin trust boundary, same per-slug single-flight — runs before Port.open, and a provision failure short-circuits exactly like open_port failure does today (:start_failed reply path). Any PROVISION built under cloud/ would sit on the wrong side of the wire and could never touch /opt/barkpark/sites.

ATOMICITY / IDEMPOTENCY PATTERN (reuse, do not invent). site-deploy.sh STAGE (lines 786-796) is the literal analog: rm -rf src.partial; mkdir; cp -a; mv src.partial -> src. Marker-guard idempotency (write a .bp-provisioned marker only after a successful rename) is the arm_caddy_* idiom repeated 4x across both deploy scripts. Provision must ONLY touch src/ — never releases/ (mkdir -p runs unconditionally pre-PLAN), current (symlink, do_switch only), or .previous.

ENV CONTRACT. Five vars are fully plumbed DB->cloud payload->box allow-list->script scrub: BARKPARK_API_URL (scoped /w/:ws/p/:proj), TOKEN (Vault-decrypted control-plane-side per deploy, reused not re-minted), DATASET, WORKSPACE, PROJECT. SITE_BASE/BUILD_ID/CONTENT_REV are synthesized by site-deploy.sh itself. The read token is minted ONCE at site-create, stored encrypted, and PublicRead IS now mounted+enforced on the scoped route BUILD fetches over (charter D6 superseded, proven by a routed integration test). PROVISION mints and revokes NOTHING — it consumes the token the payload already carries.

AMBIENT-SHADOW BUG is already closed one layer up. deploy_runner.ex child_env/1 does set-from-request-OR-remove ({key,false}) for every allow-listed key and scrubs BARKPARK_KEK/CLOAK_KEY; a protective test (deploy_runner_test.exs:180) proves an ambient BARKPARK_TOKEN cannot shadow. site-deploy.sh BUILD_ALLOW still reads ambient via ${!v}, but that only matters if a caller BYPASSES DeployRunner. So long as every deploy path goes through the Port, the collision cannot manifest. The backlog task site-spawner-backlog-build-allow-ambient is a doc-accuracy fix (site-deploy.sh header overclaims), not a security hole on the DeployRunner path.

FORCE NONCE is entirely UNBUILT (not broken). build_id/3 (deploy.ex:118-134) hashes code_rev|content_rev|config with no nonce; enqueue/2 has no force arg; the router never reads body_params["force"]; the Go CLI has no --force. Task site-spawner-deploy-force-rebuild (P1, #3214) specs the exact shape: thread force through router -> deploy_static_site -> enqueue -> build_id, fold a nonce into config ONLY when force=true; default path stays byte-identical and idempotent. CLI --force + cloudclient wiring is an additional small edit; the live-proof step-4 second deploy must pass it so rollback has two distinct builds.

BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE — the sharpest open decision, and it touches the LIVE PROOF. The astro-starter reads it (barkpark.ts:77, default "post") but it has ZERO plumbing: absent from DeployRequest.@allowed_env_keys (an unknown key is a 400 invalid_env), from deploy.ex deploy_payload, from site-deploy.sh BUILD_ALLOW, and there is no doc_type column on the Site schema. Consequence: every spawned site defaults to featuring the newest "post". If guerrilla’s bound dataset publishes "paper" not "post", fetchFlagshipDoc returns doc:null, the site builds honestly EMPTY, bp-doc-id bakes empty — and judge_live (live-proof) requires bp-doc-id NON-EMPTY. So DOC_TYPE is not cosmetic: either the live proof binds a dataset/type that has published "post" content, or DOC_TYPE must be plumbed end-to-end (4 places incl. a Site column) so the site can feature the real type. This is the crux the verify round must settle empirically.

FAIL-CLOSED GAP in the token path. deploy.ex:239-243 degrades a missing/undecryptable read token to a nil BARKPARK_TOKEN and proceeds to BUILD — fail-OPEN, contradicting the wish’s fail-closed mandate. PROVISION (or a Deploy.ex hardening) should assert a non-nil token before invoking site-deploy.sh.

FOLD-INS confirmed on the critical path. (a) slot-env clobber: instance-deploy.sh:547-549 truncate-regenerates .slots/{blue,green}.env every deploy with only PORT_OVERRIDE+MIX_BUILD_ROOT; BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 (the seam-enable flag, read at boot from that EnvironmentFile) is silently dropped on the next deploy unless the printf gains a third field. (c) CLI running-stage silence: render() (cloud_site_cmd.go:251) only prints done/failed/skipped; the box already emits "started" and it arrives as status="running" — a CLI-only fix, but keying printed[] by name-only will swallow the done-line if naively relaxed (key by name+status).

STANDALONE-FIRST nuance to state plainly: zero external ACCOUNTS holds (@barkpark/core + astro are public unauthenticated npm packages), but the box needs outbound network to registry.npmjs.org for npm ci — zero-accounts is NOT zero-network. Nobody should later "fix" this by trying to air-gap/vendor under a misreading of the law.

SLOT-ENV (F): reproduced - a BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY=1 seeded into green.env is DROPPED by the truncating printf at instance-deploy.sh:548-549. No test asserts survival today. => D38.

CLI (G): green baseline (CC=/usr/bin/clang - repo 'cc' is a Claude wrapper). TestSpawnSiteStagesOrder pins the six names. render() prints only done/failed/skipped -> BUILD streams silent; printed[] keyed by st.Name only -> a naive 'also print running' SWALLOWS the done-line. => D39 keys by name+status. A visible 7th stage = 13-file blast radius => D34 keeps provision silent.

TEARDOWN + FAIL-CLOSED (H): no DELETE /v1/sites/:id, no Registry.delete_site, no BoxRelay teardown, no de-arm mirror, no bp cloud site delete. deploy.ex:239-243 degrades a missing read token to nil BARKPARK_TOKEN and builds unauthenticated (fail-OPEN). => D37 hardens the token in drive/3; D40 defers teardown (collides with deploy-inputs on router.ex + site-deploy.sh).

CADDY ANCHOR (I): ssh guerrilla proved the arm_caddy_site_route anchor (reverse_proxy localhost:4001) EXISTS in the live Caddyfile and NO /sites/ block is present yet - the first live arm fires cleanly. Non-fatal (|| true), so the proof curls the served URL, not a green SWITCH. => D41.

COVERAGE not-founds (now decided): NO provisioning code anywhere (D33); NO DOC_TYPE plumbing + NO Site.doc_type column (D35); NO force (D36); NO teardown at any layer (D40 defer). Every load-bearing claim carried run output.

blocks.text: Decisions - D33 to D41 (mirror the charter)

content.value: D33 - PROVISION lives BOX-side, inline in DeployRunner.start_run/2 before open_port (NOT cloud/). Partial-rename src.partial->src + .bp-provisioned marker + fail-closed. Why: sole on-box executor; 12ms inline cp.
D34 - PROVISION is a SILENT pre-BUILD step, not a visible 7th stage. Why: a 7th stage is a 13-file blast radius; site-deploy.sh keeps exit-10 as a belt-and-suspenders guard.

D35 - DOC_TYPE PLUMBED END-TO-END (reversing default-and-defer). Why: the 'post' default HARD-FAILS the build and the env prefix is inert - a green proof needs doc_type=paper to reach the box. sites.doc_type (default 'post') + 6 more sites. DOC_ID deferred.

D36 - FORCE NONCE: enqueue/build_id gain a force param folding a nonce into build_id only when force; default byte-identical (the no-op test is the tripwire). router reads body_params['force']; CLI --force.
D37 - nil/undecryptable read token FAILS CLOSED in drive/3 before start_deploy. Why: today it degrades to nil BARKPARK_TOKEN -> empty content -> judge_live red.
D38 - BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY persisted across slot-env regen + regression test. Why: a redeploy drops the seam-enable flag -> route 503 -> finish line re-breaks.
D39 - CLI streams running stages keyed by (name+status) so the terminal line is never swallowed. Why: Kinsta/Vercel bar; BUILD streams silent today.

D40 - DEFERRED: teardown/DELETE (collides with deploy-inputs), @barkpark/core empty-result-throws + BARKPARK_DOC_ID (filed site-spawner-backlog-empty-result-hardening), build-allow-ambient (DeployRunner already closes the real hole), content-rev-truth, token-revoke, dataset-flag, sobelow.

D41 - Live proof binds paper, asserts >=1-published-paper, uses --force at step 4, curls the served URL for the five bp-* markers. Why: the content reality + the force nonce are what let judge_live and judge_rollback go green.

blocks.text: Wave plan - 5 slices in flight (integration-ordered)

content.value: 1. site-spawner-w4-provision [api/, fable, P0] - materialize astro-starter -> /opt/barkpark/sites/<slug>/src inline in DeployRunner.start_run/2. Gate: cd api && CC=clang MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.drop --quiet && mix ecto.create --quiet && mix ecto.migrate && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark/sites/provisioner_test.exs test/barkpark/sites/deploy_runner_test.exs.

2. site-spawner-w4-deploy-inputs [cloud/ + api/ + deploy/, fable, P0] - DOC_TYPE end-to-end + force-nonce + nil-token fail-closed. Gate: cd cloud && CC=clang MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.drop --quiet && mix ecto.create --quiet && mix ecto.migrate && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark_cloud/sites_deploy_test.exs test/barkpark_cloud/registry/site_test.exs.

3. site-spawner-w4-cli [internal/, opus, P1] - --force + --doc-type + running-stage narration (name+status). Gate: CC=/usr/bin/clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/... ./internal/cloudclient/...
4. site-spawner-w4-slot-env-persist [deploy/, opus, P1] - persist BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY across slot-env regen + regression test. Gate: bash deploy/instance-deploy_test.sh.

5. site-spawner-w4-live-proof [deploy/, fable, P0] - CAPSTONE, after 1-3 merge + guerrilla redeploys: bind paper, --force step 4, all six stages green + sub-second rollback. Gate (local): bash deploy/site-spawner-live-proof.sh --self-check; (real): the full guerrilla run.

Slices 1-4 are file-disjoint and dispatch in parallel; slice 5 is the integration capstone. Superseded: site-spawner-deploy-force-rebuild (folded into slice 2) + site-spawner-cli-running-stage-silence (folded into slice 3), both annotated in the ledger. Deferred backlog filed: site-spawner-backlog-empty-result-hardening (P2).

blocks.text: Review debrief — Wave 4 CLOSED (2026-07-14, grade A-)

The reviewer (one Fable, last hands before merge) studied every green slice's full diff vs origin/main, re-ran each slice gate to green on its final branch, checked cross-slice coherence, and audited the ledger. One fix applied in place: mix format on the two provisioner test files (loop-epic/provision-materialize-astro-starter-into-0-r). The other four slices needed no change.

SHIPPED — 1. site-spawner-w4-provision → final branch loop-epic/provision-materialize-astro-starter-into-0-r. Barkpark.Sites.Provisioner.provision/1 materializes templates/astro-starter into <sites_dir>/<slug>/src inline at the top of DeployRunner.start_run/2 (deploy only; rollback no-ops), via the STAGE partial-rename idiom (src.partial → rename → .bp-provisioned marker last), fail-closed and marker-guarded-idempotent. This is THE missing link the whole epic was stuck on. Gate: 40 tests / 0 failures. Verdict: excellent — fail-closed, self-healing, non-vacuous tests (they prove the exact path formula site-deploy.sh reads, the marker guard, and that a failure never clobbers a good src).

SHIPPED — 2. site-spawner-w4-deploy-inputs → final branch loop-epic/deploy-inputs-doc-type-end-to-end-force--1 (no reviewer change). Migration 20260714140000 adds sites.doc_type NOT NULL default 'post' (mirrors kind); doc_type flows column→cast→deploy_payload BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE→DeployRequest allowlist→site-deploy.sh BUILD_ALLOW→router. Force nonce: enqueue/3 + build_id/4 fold System.system_time only when force=true, default path byte-identical (the no-op idempotency tripwire still fires). Nil-token fail-closed in drive/3 before the box is touched (deploy-only; rollback path untouched). Gates: cloud 44/0, api 28/0. Verdict: solid; the NOT-NULL default is a safer deviation than the brief's literal spec.

SHIPPED — 3. site-spawner-w4-cli → final branch loop-epic/cli-bp-cloud-site-deploy-force-create-do-2 (no reviewer change). --force POSTs {force:true} only when set (default empty body stays idempotent); --doc-type carries doc_type,omitempty; render() narration re-keyed by (name+NUL+status) so a stage prints a running line AND a distinct terminal line (BUILD was ~38s of silence). Gate: go build/vet/test all green; gofmt clean. Wire contract matches the deploy-inputs server reads. Verdict: clean, Kinsta/Vercel-grade streaming.

SHIPPED — 4. site-spawner-w4-slot-env-persist → final branch loop-epic/slot-env-persist-barkpark-site-deploy-ap-3 (no reviewer change). write_slot_env() re-emits a prior BARKPARK_SITE_DEPLOY_APPLY line across the truncate-regen of .slots/{blue,green}.env, fail-closed (absent stays absent). Without this a redeploy silently reverts the site-deploy admin route to 503 and re-breaks the finish line. Gate: instance-deploy_test.sh ALL PASS (Case 14 added; Case 13 flock SKIP on macOS expected). Verdict: minimal, correct, matches surrounding bash style.

SHIPPED (offline) — 5. site-spawner-w4-live-proof → final branch loop-epic/live-proof-walk-all-six-stages-green-on--4 (no reviewer change). Harness adapted to the landed W4 surface: CREATE binds --doc-type (D35), judge_live asserts ALL FIVE Base.astro markers (verified present in templates/astro-starter/src/layouts/Base.astro), step-4 rollback cuts its second build with --force (D36), step-5 poison is a create-time __no_such_type__ site proving HEALTH containment two ways. Offline gate green: 24 named reds all fire, exit 0, bash -n clean. Verdict: rigorous self-check. NOTE the one inaccuracy: step-5's comment says the poison 'dies at HEALTH' — empirically a zero-doc type hard-fails at BUILD (@barkpark/core findOne throws, per D40); judge_broken accepts any named stage so the proof stays green either way, but the lead should expect BUILD, not HEALTH, in the poison narration.

GRADE: A-. Every slice on the critical path is built to the Kinsta/Vercel bar, fail-closed, and pinned by non-vacuous tests; the provision link — the actual last gap the epic was stuck on — is excellent, and cross-slice coherence is clean (flags match the server contract, file sets are disjoint, integration order is honest). The one thing keeping this off A/A+: the wish's literal finish line — a LIVE guerrilla walk of all six stages to a served URL plus a demonstrated sub-second rollback — is NOT yet run. It is BLOCKED on the five slices merging + guerrilla auto-redeploy, then the lead runs deploy/site-spawner-live-proof.sh. So the wish is delivered-pending-one-lead-run, not proven-live-this-session. That is an honest structural limitation of the wave model (you cannot run the on-box proof from a worktree), not a builder quality miss. Wave 3 was B+ with 'wish NOT met'; this wave removes the blocker and stands the proof up ready to fire — a real, earned step up.

LEDGER AUDIT: clean, no fixes needed. All 5 slice tasks are lifecycle in_progress (correct — unmerged; the lead closes the merge-gated criterion 5 on merge), each carries wave_paper=cloud-site-spawner-wave-4-2026-07-14 and parent=bp-cloud-site-spawner-epic, and each stamped its build criteria met WITH evidence as work progressed. live-proof honestly leaves its two LIVE criteria (c3 six-stage walk, c4 sub-second rollback) UNMET with a note that the lead runs the guerrilla proof post-merge — exactly right per D41. No task outside this wave was touched. Epic wave_status advanced to 'wave: complete'.

NEXT WAVE / HANDOFF: merge integration-ordered — provision (its deploy_runner_test rewrite requires the Provisioner) MUST land before deploy-inputs (whose api gate runs that same test file). .ex/.exs/.heex slices WAIT for the Elixir Test gate before merge; the CLI (Go) and slot-env (bash) may merge on their own green gates. After all five land and guerrilla auto-redeploys, the lead runs deploy/site-spawner-live-proof.sh against guerrilla and closes site-spawner-w4-live-proof c3/c4 + every slice's criterion 5. If the live proof is green, the epic wish is MET and the epic can close; if it reds, the next wave takes whatever stage it dies at. Deferred backlog remains per D40 (teardown/DELETE verb, @barkpark/core empty-result robustness + BARKPARK_DOC_ID pin, content-rev-truth, subdomain graduation).

description: Close the last gap between spawning a site and a live URL: SOURCE PROVISIONING. Materialize the Astro starter into the box, inject scoped per-site env, add the force-rebuild nonce, then walk all six deploy stages to a served, content-serving URL with sub-second rollback — PROVEN live on guerrilla.

Box-side provisioning + control-plane deploy seam for spawned sites.
